sections.label: On the preparation and use of holy water, with a prayer for purification
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 1

verses.sa: अतिसृष्टो अपां वृषभोऽतिसृष्टा अग्नयो दिव्याः॥
verses.tr: atisṛṣṭo apāṃ vṛṣabho'tisṛṣṭā agnayo divyāḥ
verses.en: The Bull of the Waters hath been let go; the heavenly fires have been let go.

verses.sa: रुजन् परिरुजन् मृणन् प्रमृणन्॥
verses.tr: rujan parirujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan
verses.en: Breaking, breaking down, crushing, crushing to pieces,

verses.sa: म्रोको मनोहा खनो निर्दाह आत्मदूषिस्तनूदूषिः॥
verses.tr: mroko manohā khano nirdāha ātmadūṣistanūdūṣiḥ
verses.en: Mroka, mind-destroying, rooting up, consuming, ruiner of the soul, ruiner of the body,

verses.sa: इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि॥
verses.tr: idaṃ tamati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhyavanikṣi
verses.en: Here I let him go: thou washest me clean of him.

verses.sa: तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: tena tamabhyatisṛjāmo yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: With this we let him loose who hates us and whom we hate.

verses.sa: अपामग्रमसि समुद्रं वोऽभ्यवसृजामि॥
verses.tr: apāmagramasi samudraṃ vo'bhyavasṛjāmi
verses.en: Thou art in front of the waters, I let loose your sea.

verses.sa: यो३प्स्व१ग्निरति तं सृजामि म्रोकं खनिं तनूदूषिम्॥
verses.tr: yo3psva1gnirati taṃ sṛjāmi mrokaṃ khaniṃ tanūdūṣim
verses.en: I let loose the Agni who is within the waters, Mroka the uprooter, the destroyer of the body.

verses.sa: यो व आपोऽग्निराविवेश स एष यद् वो घोरं तदेतत्॥
verses.tr: yo va āpo'gnirāviveśa sa eṣa yad vo ghoraṃ tadetat
verses.en: Your Agni who entered into the waters, even he here is that very dread of yours.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य व इन्द्रियेणाभि षिञ्चेत्॥
verses.tr: indrasya va indriyeṇābhi ṣiñcet
verses.en: May he anoint you with Indra's own mighty power!

verses.sa: अरिप्रा आपो अप रिप्रमस्मत्॥
verses.tr: ariprā āpo apa ripramasmat
verses.en: May stainles waters cleanse us from defilement.

verses.sa: प्रास्मदेनो वहन्तु प्र दुष्वप्न्यं वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: prāsmadeno vahantu pra duṣvapnyaṃ vahantu
verses.en: May they carry sin away from us, may they carry away from us the evil dream.

verses.sa: शिवेन मा चक्षुषा पश्यतापः शिवया तन्वोप स्पृशत त्वचं मे॥
verses.tr: śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaḥ śivayā tanvopa spṛśata tvacaṃ me
verses.en: Look on me with a friendly eye, O Waters, and touch my skin with your auspicious body.

verses.sa: शिवानग्नीनप्सुषदो हवामहे मयि क्षत्रं वर्च आ धत्त देवीः॥
verses.tr: śivānagnīnapsuṣado havāmahe mayi kṣatraṃ varca ā dhatta devīḥ
verses.en: We call the gracious Fires that dwell in waters. Goddesses, grant me princely power and splendour.

sections.label: A charm to secure various blessings
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 2

verses.sa:
निर्दुरर्मण्य ऊर्जा मधुमती वाक्॥
मधुमती स्थ मधुमतीं वाचमुदेयम्॥
verses.tr: nirdurarmaṇya ūrjā madhumatī vāk madhumatī stha madhumatīṃ vācamudeyam
verses.en: Away from distasteful food, strength and sweet speech Are pleasant, May I obtain a pleasant voice.

verses.sa: उपहूतो मे गोपाः उपहूतो गोपीथः॥
verses.tr: upahūto me gopāḥ upahūto gopīthaḥ
verses.en: I have invoked the Protector; I have invoked his protection.

verses.sa: सुश्रुतौ कर्णौ भद्रश्रुतौ कर्णौ भद्रं श्लोकं श्रूयासम्॥
verses.tr: suśrutau karṇau bhadraśrutau karṇau bhadraṃ ślokaṃ śrūyāsam
verses.en: Quick of hearing are mine ears; mine ears hear what is good. Fain would I hear a pleasant sound.

verses.sa: सुश्रुतिश्च मोपश्रुतिश्च मा हासिष्टां सौपर्णं चक्षुरजस्रं ज्योतिः॥
verses.tr: suśrutiśca mopaśrutiśca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ sauparṇaṃ cakṣurajasraṃ jyotiḥ
verses.en: Let not good hearing and overhearing fail the Eagle's eye, the undecaying light.

verses.sa: ऋषीणां प्रस्तरोऽसि नमोऽस्तु दैवाय प्रस्तराय॥
verses.tr: ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro'si namo'stu daivāya prastarāya
verses.en: Thou art the couch of the Rishis. Let worship be paid to the divine couch.

sections.label: A charm to secure power and long life
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 3

verses.sa:
मूर्धाहं रयीणां मूर्धा समानानां भूयासम्॥
रुजश्च मा वेनश्च मा हासिष्टां मूर्धा च मा विधर्मा च मा हासिष्टाम्॥
verses.tr: mūrdhāhaṃ rayīṇāṃ mūrdhā samānānāṃ bhūyāsam rujaśca mā venaśca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ mūrdhā ca mā vidharmā ca mā hāsiṣṭām
verses.en: I am the head of riches. Fain would I be the head of mine equals, Let not Ruma and Vena desert me. Let not the Head and the Preserver forsake me,

verses.sa: उर्वश्च मा चमसश्च मा हासिष्टां धर्ता च मा धरुणश्च मा हासिष्टाम्॥
verses.tr: urvaśca mā camasaśca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ dhartā ca mā dharuṇaśca mā hāsiṣṭām
verses.en: Let not the Boiler and the Cup fail me: let not the Supporter and the Sustainer abandon me,

verses.sa: विमोकश्च मार्द्रपविश्च मा हासिष्टामार्द्रदानुश्च मा मातरिश्वा च मा हासिष्टाम्॥
verses.tr: vimokaśca mārdrapaviśca mā hāsiṣṭāmārdradānuśca mā mātariśvā ca mā hāsiṣṭām
verses.en: Let not Unyoking and the Moist-fellied car desert me: let not the Sander of Moisture and Matarisvan forsake me,

verses.sa: बृहस्पतिर्म आत्मा नृमणा नाम हृद्यः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirma ātmā nṛmaṇā nāma hṛdyaḥ
verses.en: Brihaspati is my soul, he who is called the Friend of man, dear to my heart.

verses.sa: असंतापं मे हृदयमुर्वी गव्यूतिः समुद्रो अस्मि विधर्मणा॥
verses.tr: asaṃtāpaṃ me hṛdayamurvī gavyūtiḥ samudro asmi vidharmaṇā
verses.en: My heart is free from sorrow; spacious is my dwelling-place. I am the sea in capacity.

sections.label: A charm to secure long life and success
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 4

verses.sa: नाभिरहं रयीणां नाभिः समानानां भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: nābhirahaṃ rayīṇāṃ nābhiḥ samānānāṃ bhūyāsam
verses.en: I am the centre of riches. Fain would I be the centre of mine equals,

verses.sa: स्वासदसि सूषा अमृतो मर्त्येश्वा॥
verses.tr: svāsadasi sūṣā amṛto martyeśvā
verses.en: Pleasant art thou to sit by one, a mother: immortal among mortals,

verses.sa: मा मां प्राणो हासीन्मो अपानोऽवहाय परा गात्॥
verses.tr: mā māṃ prāṇo hāsīnmo apāno'vahāya parā gāt
verses.en: Let not inward breath desert me; let not outward breath depart and leave me,

verses.sa: सूर्यो माह्नः पात्वग्निः पृथिव्या वायुरन्तरिक्षाद् यमो मनुष्येऽभ्यः सरस्वती पार्थिवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sūryo māhnaḥ pātvagniḥ pṛthivyā vāyurantarikṣād yamo manuṣye'bhyaḥ sarasvatī pārthivebhyaḥ
verses.en: Let Surya protect me from Day, Agni from Earth, Vayu from Firmament, Yama from men, Sarasvati from dwellers on the earth,

verses.sa: प्राणापानौ मा मा हासिष्टं मा जने प्र मेषि॥
verses.tr: prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭaṃ mā jane pra meṣi
verses.en: Let not outward and inward breath fail me. Be not thou destructive among the men.

verses.sa: स्वस्त्य१द्योषसो दोषसश्च सर्व आपः सर्वगणो अशीय॥
verses.tr: svastya1dyoṣaso doṣasaśca sarva āpaḥ sarvagaṇo aśīya
verses.en: Propitious to-day be dawns and evenings. May I drink water with all my people safe around me.

verses.sa: शक्वरी स्थ पशवो मोप स्थेषुर्मित्रावरुणौ मे प्राणापानावग्निर्मे दक्षं दधातु॥
verses.tr: śakvarī stha paśavo mopa stheṣurmitrāvaruṇau me prāṇāpānāvagnirme dakṣaṃ dadhātu
verses.en: Mighty are ye, domestic creatures. May Mitra-varuna stand beside me, May Agni give me in- ard and outward breath. May he give me ability.
We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Grahi, the minister of Yama, Thou art the Ender, thou art Death. As such, O Sleep, we know thee well. As such preserve us from the evil dream,
We know thine origin, O Sleep, Thou art the son of Destruction, the minister of Yama, etc, (as in verse 1),
We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Misery, etc. A We know thine origin, O Sleep. Thou art the son of Disappearance, etc,
We know thine origin, O Sleep, Thou art the son of Defeat eto.

We know thine origin, O Sleep, Thou art the son of the. sisters of the Gods, the minister of Yama, Thou art the Ender, thou art Death. As such, O Sleep, we know thee well. As such, preserve us from the evil dream,

sections.label: A charm to avert evil dreams, and to transfer them to an enemy
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 6

verses.sa: अजैष्माद्यासनामाद्याभूमानागसो वयम्॥
verses.tr: ajaiṣmādyāsanāmādyābhūmānāgaso vayam
verses.en: Now have we conquered and obtained: we have been freed from sin to-day,

verses.sa: उषो यस्माद् दुष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छतु॥
verses.tr: uṣo yasmād duṣvapnyādabhaiṣmāpa taducchatu
verses.en: Let Morning with her light dispel that evil dream that frightened us.

verses.sa: द्विषते तत् परा वह शपते तत् परा वह॥
verses.tr: dviṣate tat parā vaha śapate tat parā vaha
verses.en: Bear that away to him who hates, away to him who curses us.

verses.sa: यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तस्मा एनद् गमयामः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tasmā enad gamayāmaḥ
verses.en: To him whom we abhor, to him who hates us do we send it hence,

verses.sa: उषा देवी वाचा संविदाना वाग् देव्यु१षसा संविदाना॥
verses.tr: uṣā devī vācā saṃvidānā vāg devyu1ṣasā saṃvidānā
verses.en: May the Goddess Dawn in accord with Speech, and the Goddess Speech in accord with Dawn,

verses.sa: उषस्पतिर्वाचस्पतिना संविदानो वाचस्पतिरुषस्पतिना संविदानः॥
verses.tr: uṣaspatirvācaspatinā saṃvidāno vācaspatiruṣaspatinā saṃvidānaḥ
verses.en: The Lord of Dawn in accord with the Lord of Speech and the Lord of Speech in accord with the Lord of Dawn,

verses.sa: ते३मुष्मै परा वहन्त्वरायान् दुर्णाम्नः सदान्वाः॥
verses.tr: te3muṣmai parā vahantvarāyān durṇāmnaḥ sadānvāḥ
verses.en: Carry away to Such-an-one niggard: fiends, hostile demons, and Sadanvas,

verses.sa: कुम्भीकाः दूषीकाः पीयकान्॥
verses.tr: kumbhīkāḥ dūṣīkāḥ pīyakān
verses.en: Kumbhikas, Kusikas, and Piyakas,

verses.sa: जाग्रद्दुष्वप्न्यं स्वप्नेदुष्वप्न्यम्॥
verses.tr: jāgradduṣvapnyaṃ svapneduṣvapnyam
verses.en: Evil day-dream, evil dream in sleep,

verses.sa: अनागमिष्यतो वरानवित्तेः संकल्पानमुच्या द्रुहः पाशान्॥
verses.tr: anāgamiṣyato varānavitteḥ saṃkalpānamucyā druhaḥ pāśān
verses.en: Wishes for boons that will not come, thoughts of poverty, the snares of the Druh who never. releases—

verses.sa: तदमुष्मा अग्ने देवाः परा वहन्तु वघ्रिर्यथासद् विथुरो न साधुः॥
verses.tr: tadamuṣmā agne devāḥ parā vahantu vaghriryathāsad vithuro na sādhuḥ
verses.en: This, O Agni, let the Gods bear off to Such-an-one that he may be a fragile good-for-nothing eunuch,

verses.sa: तेनैनं विध्याम्यभूत्यैनं विध्यामि निर्भूत्यैनं विध्यामि पराभूत्यैनं विध्यामि ग्राह्यैनं विध्यामि तमसैनं विध्यामि॥
verses.tr: tenainaṃ vidhyāmyabhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi nirbhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi parābhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi grāhyainaṃ vidhyāmi tamasainaṃ vidhyāmi
verses.en: Herewith I pierce this man. With poverty I pierce him. With disappearance I pierce him. With defeat I pierce him, With Grahi I pierce him. With darkness I pierce him,

verses.sa: देवानामेनं घोरैः क्रूरैः प्रैषैरभिप्रेष्यामि॥
verses.tr: devānāmenaṃ ghoraiḥ krūraiḥ praiṣairabhipreṣyāmi
verses.en: I summon him with the awful cruel orders of the Gods,

verses.sa: वैश्वानरस्यैनं दंष्ट्रयोरपि दधामि॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarasyainaṃ daṃṣṭrayorapi dadhāmi
verses.en: I place him between Vaisvanara's jaws,

verses.sa: एवानेवाव सा गरत्॥
verses.tr: evānevāva sā garat
verses.en: Thus or otherwise let her swallow him up.

verses.sa: यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि तमात्मा द्वेष्टु यं वयं द्विष्मः स आत्मानं द्वेष्टु॥
verses.tr: yo3smān dveṣṭi tamātmā dveṣṭu yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sa ātmānaṃ dveṣṭu
verses.en: Him who hates us may his soul hate, and may he whom we hate hate himself,

verses.sa: निर्द्विषन्तं दिवो निः पृथिव्या निरन्तरिक्षाद् भजाम॥
verses.tr: nirdviṣantaṃ divo niḥ pṛthivyā nirantarikṣād bhajāma
verses.en: We scorch out of heaven and earth and firmament the man who hates us.

verses.sa: सुयामंश्चाक्षुष॥
verses.tr: suyāmaṃścākṣuṣa
verses.en: Suyaman son of Chakshus!

verses.sa: इदमहमामुष्यायणे३मुष्याः पुत्रे दुष्वप्न्यं मृजे॥
verses.tr: idamahamāmuṣyāyaṇe3muṣyāḥ putre duṣvapnyaṃ mṛje
verses.en: Here I wipe away the evil dream on the descendant of Such-an-one, son of Such-a-woman.

verses.sa: यददोअदो अभ्यगच्छन् यद् दोषा यत् पूर्वां रात्रिम्॥
verses.tr: yadadoado abhyagacchan yad doṣā yat pūrvāṃ rātrim
verses.en: Whatsoever I have met with, whether at dusk or during early night,

verses.sa: यज्जाग्रद् यत् सुप्तो यद् दिवा यन्नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: yajjāgrad yat supto yad divā yannaktam
verses.en: Whether waking or sleeping, whether by day or by night,

verses.sa: यदहरहरभिगच्छामि तस्मादेनमव दये॥
verses.tr: yadaharaharabhigacchāmi tasmādenamava daye
verses.en: Whether I meet with it day by day, from that do I bribe him away.

verses.sa: तं जहि तेन मन्दस्व तस्य पृष्टीरपि शृणीहि॥
verses.tr: taṃ jahi tena mandasva tasya pṛṣṭīrapi śṛṇīhi
verses.en: Slay him; rejoice in this; crush his ribs.

verses.sa: स मा जीवीत् तं प्राणो जहातु॥
verses.tr: sa mā jīvīt taṃ prāṇo jahātu
verses.en: Let him not live. Let the breath of life forsake him.

Whatever we have gained, whatever hath accrued to us, our Right, our energy, our Devotion, our heavenly light, our sacrifice, our domestic animals, our offspring, our men,—from all share herein we exclude Such-an-one, descendant of Such-an-one, son of Such-a-woman. Let him not be freed from the noose of Grahi. Here I bind up his splendour, his energy, his vital breath, his life, and cast him down beneath me,
Whatever we have gained, etc. (as in verse 1). Let him not be freed from the noose of Nirriti, etc.
Whatever we have gained, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of misery, etc.

Whatever we have gained, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of Prajapati, etc.
Whatever we have gained, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Rishis, etc.
Whatever we have gained, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of the Rishis' children, etc,
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of the Angirases, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Angirases, etc.
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of the Atharvans, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Atharvans, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Trees, etc,
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of Shrubs, etc.

Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Season-groups, etc.

Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of the Half-months, etc.
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of Day and Night, etc,
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of continued Day, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of Heaven and Earth, etc.
Whatever, etc, Let him not be freed from the noose of Indra-agni, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of Mitra-varuna, etc.
Whatever, etc. Let him not be freed from the noose of King Varuna, etc.

Whatever we have gained, whatever hath accrued to us, our Right, our energy, our Devotion, our heavenly light, our sacrifice, our domestic animals, our offspring, our men,—from all share herein we exclude Such-an-one, descendant of Such-an-one, son of Such-a-woman, Let him not be freed from the fetter and noose of Death, Here I bind up his splendour, his energy, his vital breath, his life, and cast him down beneath me.

sections.label: A charm to secure wealth and felicity
sections.name: Book 16, hymn 9

verses.sa: जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमभ्यऽष्ठां विश्वाः पृतना अरातीः॥
verses.tr: jitamasmākamudbhinnamasmākamabhya'ṣṭhāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā arātīḥ
verses.en: Ours is superior place and ours is conquest: may I in all fights tread down spite and malice.

verses.sa: तदग्निराह तदु सोम आह पूषा मा धात् सुकृतस्य लोके॥
verses.tr: tadagnirāha tadu soma āha pūṣā mā dhāt sukṛtasya loke
verses.en: This word hath Agni, this hath Soma spoken, May Pushan set me in the world of virtue.

verses.sa: अगन्म स्वः१ स्वऽरगन्म सं सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषागन्म॥
verses.tr: aganma svaḥ1 sva'raganma saṃ sūryasya jyotiṣāganma
verses.en: We have come to the light of heaven; to the light of heaven have we come: we have united with the light of Sarya,

verses.sa: वस्योभूयाय वसुमान् यज्ञो वसु वंसिषीय वसुमान् भूयासं वसु मयि धेहि॥
verses.tr: vasyobhūyāya vasumān yajño vasu vaṃsiṣīya vasumān bhūyāsaṃ vasu mayi dhehi
verses.en: Sacrifice is fraught with wealth for the increase of prosperity. I would win riches; fain would I be wealthy. Do thou bestow wealth upon me,
